The Demon Deacons were led by first-year head coach [[Steve Forbes (basketball)|Steve Forbes]] and played their home games at the [[Lawrence Joel Veterans Memorial Coliseum]] in [[Winston-Salem, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The Demon Deacons finished the season 6–16, 3–15 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], to finish in fourteenth place. They lost to [[2020–21 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]] in the first round of the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. They were not invited to either the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] or [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Demon Deacons]] finished [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 13–17, 6–14 in [[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a tie for 13th place. They lost to [[2019–20 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]] in the first round of the [[2020 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. The tournament was cancelled before the Quarterfinals due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |title=Statement from ACC on Men's Basketball Tournament |url=https://theacc.com/news/2020/3/12/statement-from-acc-on-mens-basketball-tournament.aspx |website=theacc.com |publisher=Atlantic Coast Conference |accessdate=12 March 2020}} The [[2020 NCAA
